check: scaled canvas pixel preservation and immediate source backing-store release
environment: Chromium 155, Pixel 10 mobile emulation; source served at localhost:5191
method: Compare every RGBA byte against a separate Canvas2D downsample using the original dimensions and identical smoothing settings, then inspect source dimensions and identity.
callerReview: All four callers only retain the returned canvas texture. Sign and metro UV maps use dimensions calculated before scaling. No caller reads the temporary source canvas after scaling.
scope: Verifies pixel behavior and explicit release of temporary canvas capacity. Does not prove iPhone Safari memory usage or end-to-end crash resolution.
